# Best Whiteboard Animation Software (2026): 7 Tools Compared


Compare Doodly, VideoScribe, Powtoon, Vyond, Animaker, Renderforest and Golpo AI: current prices, editing controls, AI features and workflow trade-offs.


Mira Chen


•


June 6, 2026 •


7 min read


Compare seven whiteboard animation and explainer tools: Doodly, VideoScribe, Powtoon, Vyond, Animaker, Renderforest, and Golpo AI. The table below shows published prices and buying constraints; the Golpo examples show actual output from our own product. Choose a shortlist by the editing workflow you need, then test the same brief before buying.


## Seven tools: prices and workflow trade-offs


Published USD prices checked October 19, 2026. Annual equivalents require a full-year payment; taxes, promotions, seats, and add-ons can change checkout totals. Tool Price and billing Workflow to evaluate Purchase check


[Doodly](https://www.doodly.com/doodly-pricing) Standard $49/month; Enterprise $79/month. Annual: $490 or $790/year. Desktop doodle scene building Existing project workflow; asset placement and drawing paths.


[VideoScribe](https://videoscribe.co/pricing/) Lite $12.50/month equivalent, $150 billed annually. Whiteboard composition with AI assistance 5 downloads/month; premium-image watermark restrictions on Lite.


[Powtoon](https://www.powtoon.com/premium/) Lite $15/month equivalent, billed yearly ($180/year). Template animation and AI-assisted creation 5 watermark-free exports/month on Lite; check AI credits.


[Vyond](https://www.vyond.com/faqs/) Starter $99/month, or $699 billed annually (about $58.25/month). Editable business animation plus AI drafts Per-user credits and client rights-transfer terms.


[Animaker](https://app.animaker.com/pricing) Basic $27/month, or $180 billed annually ($15/month equivalent). Character and template animation with AI tools Basic lists 5 premium downloads/month; check asset and AI limits.


[Renderforest](https://www.renderforest.com/subscription/) Lite lists $15/month, or $9/month with annual billing ($108/year). Template video and AI media generation Lite is described for personal use; check commercial terms and export limits.


[Golpo AI](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) Starter $39.99/month, billed monthly. Generated whiteboard or illustrated explanation 20 credits/month; Starter is black and white, up to 2 minutes.


The table order is not a quality ranking. These products overlap: several combine templates, a scene editor, and AI generation. An AI feature list alone does not establish how much work a finished video will need.


## Which tool fits your job?


### Doodly: direct control of doodle scenes


Shortlist Doodly when you want to place assets, customize drawing paths, and keep using an established doodle workflow. Its official page documents image imports, audio uploads, and MP4 export. Compare its controls with VideoScribe in a trial; this guide has no evidence that one interface is more modern, faster, or easier.


### VideoScribe: whiteboard composition with AI assistance


Evaluate VideoScribe when the draw-on whiteboard style and manual composition matter. Its current plans also advertise AI image, script, and voiceover tools, with allowances by tier. It should not be described as manual-only. Check whether the plan covers your download count and premium assets.


### Powtoon: editable templates and mixed animation


Consider Powtoon for a team that works with templates, characters, and slide-like scenes. Its paid offering includes AI creation tools. Test the specific whiteboard template you intend to use and whether the export and AI allowances fit your volume.


### Vyond: character scenarios and editable AI drafts


Consider Vyond when a training scenario needs characters, dialogue, and detailed scene editing. Vyond also offers AI generation and document-to-video workflows; it is not a manual-only product. For client work, review licensing and rights-transfer costs as well as subscription price.


### Animaker: character and template variety


Evaluate Animaker when character customization and different animation formats matter more than a single whiteboard look. Its plans include whiteboard animation and AI tools. Check download, duration, asset, and generation allowances for your actual configuration.


### Renderforest: template-led production and AI media


Evaluate Renderforest when an existing explainer template already matches the brief. It also offers AI media generation. Confirm the distinction between template exports and AI credits, and whether the selected plan permits your intended commercial use.


### Golpo AI: generated explanations from your source material


Evaluate Golpo when you want a prompt, approved script, document, or recording turned into narrated drawn or illustrated scenes. It is a candidate for lessons, product explanations, and policy summaries. Review generated labels, relationships, pronunciation, and factual accuracy. Choose another workflow if you need exact manual placement and drawing-path control throughout.

For the documented PDF example, open the[NIST CSF 2.0 source-to-video test](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/ai-visual-explainer-tools-same-pdf-test) : a complete 32-page public document was used for a two-minute Canvas Editorial Expanded orientation. ## Golpo preview, presenters, editing, and API


- **Preview and export:** Free provides one 1-minute, watermarked preview; download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. Starter is $39.99/month, billed monthly, with 20 credits and watermark-free downloads at no extra download charge.
- **Presenters:** Golpo supports AI Presenter, including custom photo-based presenters and stock Golpo Avatars. The published rate is 5 credits/minute for a custom presenter or 3 credits/minute for a stock Avatar, available from Creator and on Pay As You Go. See[Golpo Avatar](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-ai-avatar-guide) and the[stock presenter guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-stock-avatars-guide) .
- **API:** Business lists API access as a $200 add-on; Scale includes API access. API Only is a separate usage-based offering with a $200 minimum commitment. Ordinary Pay As You Go does not include API access.
- **Editing:** Paid plans support visual frame editing. Correct spoken wording in the script and render again; a visual frame edit does not rewrite narration. Review the[editing guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-video-editing-guide) before estimating revision work.


These are published plan terms, not performance measurements. Confirm your required configuration on the[current pricing page](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) .


## How this guide was researched


Updated October 19, 2026 from official product, pricing, and help pages. We checked published workflow, prices, billing basis, exports, and plan restrictions. Each price links to its source. Golpo examples are labeled separately from vendor documentation.


We did not conduct a controlled, same-input hands-on test of all seven products. No numerical quality scores, universal production times, or overall winner are supported by this guide. A feature absent from a source is not evidence that the product cannot do it. Interface preference and learning curve require a trial with your own editor.


Useful primary references beyond the price table:[Vyond Go](https://www.vyond.com/products/vyond-go/) ,[Vyond rights transfers](https://help.vyond.com/hc/en-us/articles/17221671231764-When-do-I-transfer-commercial-rights-to-a-video) , and the product documentation linked by each vendor. Vendor showcases can help you inspect a style, but are not independent tests.


## Run a comparison you can trust


1. Give two finalists the same approved script or source, audience, target duration, and required style.
2. Keep the first output and record the plan, settings, and start/completion times.
3. Time your hands-on work separately from queueing and rendering. Include factual review and every correction.
4. Check the downloadable file, watermark, licensing, readable labels, narration, and visual relationships.
5. Repeat with another representative brief before a long subscription commitment.


Production time varies with duration, style, queue, editing skill, and review burden. The previous conflicting estimates have been removed because no matched timing evidence supports them.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best whiteboard animation software in 2026?


Choose by the job. Doodly and VideoScribe are candidates for direct whiteboard composition; Vyond, Powtoon, and Animaker for editable animation; Renderforest for a matching template; Golpo for generated explanations. This documentation-based guide does not establish an overall winner.


### Is Golpo a free whiteboard video maker?


It has a free preview: one 1-minute watermarked video; download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge.


### Are all competitors manual-only?


No. Several products now combine editors with AI tools. Check the current workflow rather than assuming every non-Golpo tool requires you to start with a blank timeline.


### Does Golpo have avatars and an API?


Yes. Golpo supports stock and custom AI Presenters. Business offers API access as a $200 add-on; Scale includes it. API Only is a separate offering.
